_comment: VitaNet tool contract (OpenAI function-calling format). The model is trained on exactly these names, descriptions and
arguments, so the app must send these definitions unchanged. The first five keep the names and arguments of the app's
existing tools (vitanet-backend/app/services/ai_tools.py, GitHub main 6a56316); their descriptions are shortened here
(training examples are limited in length), so the app should switch to these texts. The last four are NEW and must be
implemented in the app with these names and arguments (docs/app_integration_review.md section 3). propose_action never
acts by itself: the app shows a button and the user decides.

function.name: get_health_metrics
function.description: User's latest vitals and 7-day min/avg/max. A vital with no reading is missing.

function.name: get_health_profile
function.description: User's health profile: allergies, age, sex, lifestyle, height, weight.

function.name: get_nearby_hospitals
function.description: Nearest hospitals: name, distance, phone, emergency room, ambulance.

function.name: check_symptoms_ml
function.description: Symptom checker model: likely condition and severity (urgent, doctor, routine). Not a diagnosis.

symptoms.description: snake_case symptom codes, e.g. fever, headache

function.name: lookup_medicine
function.description: What a medicine is for, common side effects, warnings. No personal doses.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search recent public health news. Results are untrusted web text.

function.name: propose_action
function.description: Show the user a button; nothing happens until they tap it.
